description: This file defines the ResultSet class for 'Dish' in the Coocook schema, including methods for creating dishes from recipes, summing servings, filtering dishes by date, and updating/deleting dish items.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::Dish
classes.description: ResultSet class for handling collections of Dish objects, with methods for creating dishes from recipes, filtering by date, and batch updating/deleting.

methods.name: from_recipe
methods.description: Creates a new Dish object based on a given recipe, with optional arguments for meal, comment, and servings, copying tags and ingredients from the recipe.

methods.name: sum_servings
methods.description: Calculates the total sum of servings for the dishes in the result set.

methods.name: in_past_or_today
methods.description: Returns dishes associated with meals scheduled on or before today.

methods.name: in_future
methods.description: Returns dishes associated with meals scheduled after today.

methods.name: update_items_and_delete
methods.description: Performs a transaction to update items and delete dishes in the result set.
